children: Our Bureau Mumbai: Aditya Birla Capital's consolidated net profit rose 38% year-on-year to 1,288 crore in the quarter ended September 2026, driven by strong growth in its lending and insurance businesses. Revenue rose 31% to 16,545 crore in the second quarter FY27.

The company's total lending assets under management, comprising its non-banking finance and housing finance businesses, rose 32 to 2.34 lakh crore as of September 30. The company's net interest margin for the quarter stood at 6.00% vs 6.06% a year ago. The net interest income rose 23% to Rs 2,466 crore. The NBFC business reported a 26% year-on-year increase in AUM to 1.77 lakh crore, while disbursements rose 12% to 24,708 crore. Profit before tax grew 41% to 1,352 crore. Return on assets improved by 25 basis points to 2.45%. Asset quality improved, with the NBFC's gross stage 2 and stage 3 ratio declining by 72 basis points year-on-year to 2.31%.

title: Aditya Birla Capital Q2 Profit up 38%
